objective: Test whether the frozen numerical PLE feature map improves the fixed E540 one-epoch FP32 model relative to the previously completed, same-recipe linear control. This is a bounded mechanism screen, not a public-forecast claim.

changed_factor.name: candidate numeric map: linear to train-only PLE
changed_factor.reason: The V8 linear fixed-epoch-0 control completed all updates but the V8 worker stopped on a provenance-hash source mismatch before candidate fitting. V9 reuses that control and freshly fits only PLE.
changed_factor.control: Reuse own independently trained E540 V8 linear epoch-0 checkpoint, validated against its sibling provenance.json and V8 source/recipe/subset receipts.
changed_factor.candidate: Fresh PLE fit from scratch under the same fixed one-epoch FP32 training recipe and seed.

reuse_control.v8_terminal_status: worker failed after linear training on receipt hash-source mismatch; checkpoint artifacts were downloaded and SHA-256-verified

data.evaluation_membership_order: V8 training provenance records the same 468 members in source row order; worker requires unique-set equality and both V9 feature-only predictions follow the frozen subset manifest order

loader.omitted_sequence_identity: unknown; actual sampler row indices were not saved
loader.sampler_order: same seed/configuration; V9 requires the PLE provenance sample_order_identity to exactly equal the reused V8 control identity

data.prediction_reads: features only; target and is_scored mask columns are not requested

numeric_map.candidate: PLE: eight train-only quantile intervals per raw channel, 1,008 cumulative ramp coordinates plus 112 unbounded standardized raw bypass coordinates, followed by 99 event coordinates; expanded input width 1,107
numeric_map.control: linear allocation with the same 1,008 ramp slots and raw bypass, but only the bypass coordinates are active

loss.name: wmse
loss.denominator: sum of both target weights over each 256-row chunk
loss.validity_mask: existing repository warmup validity; identical in both arms

shared_model.effective_capacity_caveat: The allocated parameter shapes match, while the effective numeric-map capacity differs; this remains an explicit comparison confound.

profile_and_fit.grad_stats: --grad-stats records every pre-clip gradient norm; profile and fit require exact count and zero nonfinite steps
profile_and_fit.finite_loss_gate: All 316 profile losses must be finite; trainer fit and history must complete fixed epoch 0
profile_and_fit.projected_work_gate: Fresh V9 PLE profile projects its one full fit plus both 468-group exports and 300-second margin within the actual worker cap; no profile speed is imputed from V8.
profile_and_fit.gate_failure: No PLE fitting if the profile or projection gate fails.

prediction_and_grade.export: feature-only prediction arrays and sidecars; no ONNX or full-training export on this screen path

authorization.scope: Permit only the PLE fit after its exact-update, finite-loss, complete GradStats, allocator-memory and projected-runtime profile gate passes. The V8 linear control is already trained and only undergoes validation plus feature-only export.

execution.startup: actual PLE profile/fit and both prediction parsers, root authorization, and private-control identity are validated before mounted training-data hashing; no Torch import before data/split/membership identity checks
